Separately sourced orca gargoyle alternatives, 2026-11-24

The 32 rows in historical-stabilized-orca-alternatives.txt cover the two
orca gargoyle stones and the two cornice stones, seeds 5 and 11, and hull,
clumps, quick and demo. Every row differs from its original, unmodified-f8
row. All 32 separately match the independently captured b74ee1ba current
rows byte for byte. These alternatives do not replace the original records.

The alternative source is unmodified historical commit
f8ddbbbba211d5cb4ec6ca0a1775303ff6fce4b4 plus only the production hunk of
0551dc30 that stabilizes the orca flipper normal with math.FMA. The isolated
source commit was c321e0f067fd8fcdb89bd0ff15e68817c2fbf290; its sole
production diff is preserved as historical-orca-flipper-stabilization.patch.
No caller-specific or species-specific production branch was introduced.

Why this is separately sourced. On the plain-arithmetic historical parent
72727dfc, a same-binary probe retained the f8 gargoyle digest and measured
flipper-normal X = 1.9955116307308054e-17. In that same test binary, the
unchanged binding witness introduced with 0551 fails: it requires
X = 1.053477413162646e-17. In clean f8 with the explicit FMA, the same
binding witness passes and the unchanged historical gargoyle check fails,
instead obtaining the current, different digest. The original
and stabilized results thus expose different rounded historical inputs;
the separately sourced alternatives record that fact without deleting or
rewriting either witness.

The affected cornice trace held 370 things: only the orca mesh changed;
all placements, material fields and sharing indices matched. Meshes each
had 75,817 indexed points and 151,110 identically indexed faces. Thirty-nine
positions differed, by at most 1.3322676295501878e-15 in Euclidean distance;
202 indexed vertices' normals differed, by at most 2.5632691087507654e-14.
The recorded values are exact-byte comparisons, not a claim of visible change.

Capture used Darwin arm64, Go 1.27.3, GOWORK=off, GOMAXPROCS=2, the
selected public producer and Game tests-lane per-kind tickets, with each
case bounded to 120 seconds and 4 GiB sampled RSS, and a 30-GiB disk floor.
All 32 succeeded, taking 96.44 seconds in total excluding lane waits. The
largest sampled peak was 316,704 KiB; sampling can miss short-lived peaks.
The independently captured b74 comparison used the identical producer source.

SHA-256:
  unmodified f8 orca_skin.go  56267c58934f1ccf8026d2b60a2ec268f9e7d0321f074d32b00858dabdd448b7
  stabilized orca_skin.go    25b6e754c6173a850a906c8144053f6f240415c0fc163347bb4f9525c3ab81c0
  exact production patch     8d9d424970050927664bfdebd8599db54875dee7ad60e194d6e979d8026d6d7a
  selected producer source   3551acf3fca97e5c118f0c3b76db5342bd4d2a56386471ada6185d2287328094
  stabilized producer binary 8eaca4b09bf710b11938eb3cfa231d1aff4fb9bb78fceded3f73bbcad33a6b8c
  stabilized 32 rows        1d5d241dd34be203d62e5433ec2337c774bc7aa8fec5d0885a5860b59a6e950f

The identical test-only probe patch for both cases is preserved as
historical-orca-probe.patch, with SHA-256
2b332626d9390c4520cbfc0ebb52b60b988f0b39fab8e593ae3f59ba5eab72e5.
The original Game output is in history/orca-arithmetic-evidence/. Both
probe runs intentionally fail one of the two unchanged exact witnesses.

An additional control applied the same test-only patch to clean unmodified
f8, without changing its production source. Its test binary evaluated the
plain Cross expression to the right-fused value: the binding witness passed
and the original standalone-producer gargoyle digest failed. On 72727dfc
with the identical test-only patch, the initializer evaluated to the other
rounded value and the outcomes reversed. This shows the unfenced source is
sensitive to compilation context; the original f8 rows were captured by
the separately recorded standalone producer, not this test binary.

The three control probes use the identical patch above, applied respectively
to 72727dfc, f8 plus the stabilization patch, and clean f8. Their isolated
source commits were c5ea92dc01e2c772a87b56d1742d4ea0b0392791,
96caf0ab700eaac6881aca02b53f29d0ea38cc3a, and
3d7e091ad163d34561ec02c1473b73c04fe2d10e. The original Game outputs are
preserved alongside this record.

Both source patches use zero context; apply each from the appropriate
historical checkout with git apply --unidiff-zero. Applying the production
patch to f8 and the probe patch to each of the three named control bases
reconstructed every corresponding source file byte-for-byte.

The original selected producer is reconstructed as documented in
historical-selected-producer-provenance.txt.
